subject: Re: Psi Health discovery — pilot scope & SDK/funcall approach
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@psi.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & pilot ask

Evelyn / Sergio —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned:

- Primary pain: triage latency and search relevance for inbound clinical messages (current infra averages ~1s per query and poor recall on short queries).
- Goal: replace our current embedding+rerank pipeline for triage + generate short structured summaries for downstream EHR ingestion.
- Non-negotiables: PII handling controls, SOC 2 evidence, and the ability to keep inference in us-east region.

What we discussed as a feasible pilot: a 2-week sandbox to validate your streaming funcall flow for summary generation + an embedding rerank POC on a 50k-row sample. Success metrics: median tech latency < 300ms, rerank NDCG improvement >= 0.12, and budget ~ $2k–$4k for pilot.

I attached a small sample export (psi_poc_data_sample.csv) and a short list of example queries. Would you confirm next steps and the proposed owners?

Thanks —
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Integrations
Psi Health

Attachment: psi_poc_data_sample.csv (csv, 48KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@psi.health>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & pilot ask

Alex —

Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming receipt of the sample and that your pilot goals are realistic. High-level reply and proposed scope: 

- Pilot scope we recommend:
  * Streaming function calls: run inference-as-you-type/streamed tokens for the structured summary generator (we’ll provide a small SDK adaptor for your back end).
  * Embedding + rerank: batch embed the 50k sample, evaluate candidate rerankers (ANN-backed) and ship a simple scoring layer for comparison.
  * Security: supply SOC 2 artifacts and region pin (us-east) via our Private deployment controls for the pilot.

- Timeline: kickoff within 3 business days, ingest & baseline 2–3 days, integration + iteration 7–10 days, wrap + metrics 1–2 days.

- Owners: Evelyn (AM) — project coordination & success criteria; Sergio (Solutions Eng) — technical lead and SDK adaptor; Ben (Sales Eng) — pricing & contract.

Action items for you: share the target success queries and confirm if the sample contains PHI (so we set appropriate handling). We’ll push a short pilot proposal PDF (redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf) to the Drive and a HubSpot deal.

Next steps I’ll take now: create the pilot playbook, add proposed function call schema, and schedule a 30m kickoff for Thursday.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn Hart | redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@psi.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Carmen Li <carmen.li@psi.health>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & pilot ask

Evelyn —

Thanks, that timeline looks good. A few clarifications from our infra/security team: 

1) Sample: contains de-identified clinical notes, so no PHI.
2) Function call schema: Carmen (cc) will own the target structured schema — she wants the generated summary to output JSON with fields {"triage_code","summary_text","confidence_score","entities":[]} — is that compatible with your funcall interface?
3) Token budget: we expect average inputs to be ~250 tokens and want to understand cost sensitivity if we move to production.

We confirm Thursday kickoff at 11:00am ET. Please include the Drive link and any CORS/SDK install notes for our infra.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@psi.health>, Carmen Li <carmen.li@psi.health>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & pilot ask — technical plan & owners

Alex / Carmen —

Thanks — quick technical follow-up and concrete action items before kickoff: 

- Funcall compatibility: yes — we’ll expose a streaming funcall endpoint that returns a JSON envelope matching your requested schema. We’ll supply a reference TypeScript SDK snippet and a small adaptor to map Redwood funcall outputs to {triage_code, summary_text, confidence_score, entities}.

- Embedding + rerank approach:
  * Step 1: one-time batch embed of your 50k sample (we’ll estimate ~20 GPU-minutes using our default fp16 quantized embedder).
  * Step 2: run candidate rerankers (cosine + lightweight learned scorer) and compute NDCG. Expect ~3–4 evaluation runs to converge.

- Latency & cost guidance: aiming for median < 300ms for streaming summary generation when tokenized inputs are <= 300 tokens. Pilot cost estimate: $3,200 (includes compute + engineering time) — Ben will follow up with a formal quote.

- Security/compliance: Evelyn will share SOC 2 artifacts. We’ll run the pilot in a dedicated us-east tenancy with request-level logging turned on; retention policy can be set to 30 days for the pilot.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Evelyn: share kickoff calendar invite and pilot success matrix (by EOD today).
- Alex / Carmen: confirm sample is de-identified & share 5 canonical queries (by Wed EOD).
- Sergio: prepare SDK adaptor + schema examples and run a dry embed baseline (by Thu morning).
- Ben: send pilot quote & standard MSA addendum (by Thu EOD).

We’ll use the HubSpot record (link in the Drive doc) for formal approvals. Looking forward to the kickoff Thursday 11:00am ET.

—Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
